description: This file defines a custom class 'Table' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Util\V1\Dto' that extends Doctrine's Schema Table class. It provides methods to set a schema manager, add columns, and create the table in the database, encapsulating some database schema operations for the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A subclass of Doctrine's Schema Table with additional functionality for setting a schema manager, adding columns, and creating the table.

methods.name: setSchemaManager
methods.description: Sets the schema manager used to create database tables.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to the table with specified name, type, and options, returning the 'Table' instance for chaining.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Executes SQL to create this table in the database using the schema manager.
